content.rendered:
Download WWE 2K24 PPSSPP – PSP Iso Save Data Textures for Android, with real wrestlers faces and moves, updated roster.

WWE 2K24 PPSSPP is a wrestling game that works well on Android PSP emulator, you can find your favourite wrestlers in the game and use them to start a real wrestling match. 

As the new edition of WWE 2K24 PSP Iso is out you get to enjoy the new features that comes with the game on your Android device such as new wrestlers moves that have been added. 

It has now even become bigger than ever as you can see your self holding that WWE heavy weight title by your right hand after winning your match in the wrestling ring. 

WWE 2K24 PPSSPP – PSP Iso has main events such as SummerSlam, WrestleMania and many more with over 100 wrestlers competing to win the title. 

Your favourite wrestlers can be found in the WWE PSP 2k24 game such as Roman Rains, Dominic Mysterio, AJ Styles, Seth Rolins, Jimmy Uso, Karl Anderson, Becky lynch and more. 

Women division has been updated in the latest PPSSPP – PSP WWE 2K24 for the Android emulator, you can play tag team with them easily and win your match. 

Features Of WWE 2K24 PPSSPP – PSP Iso Save Data Textures 

  • Over 275 modded PSP roster. 
  • New moves added such as, curb stomp, coddy cutter, cesaro swing, BFT, RKO, Guillotine choke etc. 
  • New Arenas with full lightening and fans cheering, updated ramps and billboards 
  • WWE, NXT, legends roster added. 
  • Road to WrestleMania added and working. 
  • 6-Man, 4-Man, 2-Man Tag team are working.
  • All championship belts now working. 
  • Titantron updated. 
  • Commentary table added during matches.
  • Commentary updated and more realistic. 

 Download WWE 2K24 PPSSPP – PSP Iso Save Data Textures

How To Install Or Set Up WWE 2K24 PPSSPP – PSP Iso

Here are the steps to follow in other to extract WWE 2K24 PPSSPP – PSP Iso Save Data Textures files in your Android device.

  1. Using Installed Zarchiver App, open it and locate downloaded WWE 2K24 file. 
  2. Click on it, options menu will come up. 
  3. Click Extract and navigate to Device Memory or Home menu of Zarchiver app. 
  4. Wait there and click Extract Icon which looks like a arrow pointing downwards. 
  5. WWE 2K24 file will be extracted immediately, while extracting a PSP folder will be created, inside it you will find the Iso Save data and textures files for the WWE 2K24.
